shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab/pillar
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
row of repeated small motifs along a band
human or humanoid figure in a seated/crouching pose
symbolic winged/spread motif near the top
justification: Both are upright slabs carved in shallow relief and divided into stacked horizontal registers, each containing profile animals, a crouching/seated humanoid figure and repeated small motifs in a strip, which gives a similar overall gestalt of a register-organised relief. But the specific content differs sharply: A shows a row of large crouching quadrupeds along the top edge, a fringed/zigzag band, a large predator-headed beast, a bird's head and a plant-like frond, while B shows a winged disc, dense script-like signs, seated human figures with raised arms and offering tables — none of the specific motifs or their relationships correspond.
